About Ecogenesis

Empowering people through education, training & action

Ecogenesis is committed to the empowerment of individuals and local communities who face environmental issues — preserving cultural, religious, and indigenous earth wisdom along the way.

Who We Are

An organization for the environment, and for people

Ecogenesis is an organization that aims to empower individuals and groups through education, training and action (application). It is concerned with health and the environment, and is committed to the empowerment of individuals and local communities who face environmental issues.

It seeks to help preserve cultural and religious (spiritual) values and indigenous earth wisdom, and promotes a wholistic and integrative spirituality focused on the care of the environment.

Our mission focuses on: the environment, local communities, farmers, indigenous people, youth, women & children, and churches & schools.

Our Mission

Care of the Earth and all that live in it

To cultivate a mutuality between the environment and the human community. It promotes the vision and mission of Pope Francis' encyclical Laudato Si (Care of the Earth, our Common Home) and of the United Nations' Earth Charter Initiative — building a One Earth Community.

Our Vision

An Earth in its fullness is fullness of life for all

A nurtured environment, a healthy existence for all. Ecogenesis provides, through scholarships, individuals and members of organizations who share similar mission and goals the opportunity for training and education.

Who We Serve

The environment, local communities & farmers

Our programs reach indigenous people, youth, women & children, and churches & schools — anyone ready to learn, train, and act for the health of their land and their community.

Our Approach

Permaculture, community, and a wholistic spirituality

We develop and maintain a permaculture-designed farm; provide education and training in the care of the environment and in alternative medicine; help build inclusive ecology-conscious communities (eco-villages & small faith communities); and promote sustainable, ecology-friendly commerce including eco-tourism.

Our Goals

What we're working toward

Develop a permaculture eco-farm

Develop and maintain a permaculture-designed farm.

Educate & train

Provide education and training in care of the environment and in alternative medicine.

Build eco-villages

Help build inclusive ecology-conscious communities — eco-villages & small faith communities.

Sustainable, ecology-conscious economy

Promote sustainable development and ecology-friendly commerce, including eco-tourism.

Our Approach To Healing

Healing the Person, the Community, the Environment, the Earth

Healing is a process of becoming healthy — moving towards wholeness and fullness of life. There is an interconnectedness among all living things; what happens to one affects another, and impacts the whole.
